mathematics.final_validator: F0-02 PinocchioFK, independently recomputed from q_candidate
mathematics.profile_rule: finite correct shape AND inclusive joint limits AND position <= threshold AND orientation <= threshold
mathematics.first_hit: First custom-FK pose evaluation satisfying each profile; initial q is iteration 0. These diagnostics do not replace final independent FK validation.
mathematics.iteration_count: Number of completed projected updates. No iteration started: null and NOT_AVAILABLE; initial valid evaluation: zero and AVAILABLE.
mathematics.stall: 5 consecutive projected updates with infinity norm <= 1e-12 rad while Profile B is unsatisfied; no residual-based early stopping
mathematics.success_identity: pose only; q_candidate need not equal q_target

query_generation.main: Sequential independent uniform(lower,upper,size=6) draws from query_seed PCG64 stream.
query_generation.boundary: Separate boundary_query_seed stream. For each candidate draw uniform 6-vector, then u=random(); overwrite joint (accepted_index//2)%6 at lower for even accepted_index or upper for odd, at u*0.02 of joint range; require strict min normalized distance <0.02. A rejected candidate does not advance accepted_index.
query_generation.singularity: Separate singularity_query_seed stream; sequential uniform 6-vector candidates; accept normalized F0-03 sigma_min <= frozen F0-04 train-only threshold. Never refit threshold on queries.
query_generation.uniqueness: Reject exact q duplicates against ALL verified F0-04 main train/validation/test and boundary/singularity shards and all already accepted F0-05 subsets. Canonical q key: C-order little-endian float64 bytes with signed zero normalized to +0. No rounding.
query_generation.ids: query_id=f05-{subset}-{accepted_index:08d}; query_group_id=root-f05-{subset}-{accepted_index:08d}; one independent root per query, no perturbation families. Reject ID/group intersections with F0-04 and across subsets.
query_generation.target_pose: PinocchioFK(q_target); canonical F0-04 wxyz sign; cross-check IndependentFK position and rotation Frobenius <=1e-9.
query_generation.q_target_access: Query generation, target verification and offline independence audit only. Solver receives only q_current, target position, target quaternion, deadline. Never target joints or query objects.
query_generation.start_class: Within each subset, even accepted_index=local, odd=wide. Exactly 5000/5000 main and 500/500 each hard subset.
query_generation.local: One PCG64(local_start_seed) stream continued across subset order; q_current=q_target+uniform(-0.05,0.05,size=6); reject limits or exact equality; no clamp.
query_generation.wide: One PCG64(wide_start_seed) stream continued across subset order; uniform joint box; require sqrt(mean(((q_current-q_target)/(upper-lower))**2)) >=0.25.
query_generation.rejection: Consume each rejected draw without reseeding. Record proposed/accepted/rejected counts by subset and reason, target candidate ordinal per query, and start attempts per query. Exceeding configured candidate cap is an error, not relaxed acceptance.
query_generation.list_encoding: UTF-8 LF JSONL; json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), terminal LF on every row; subset/accepted_index order; file SHA256 is query_list_sha256 and content identity. No path/timing metadata in content.
query_generation.reuse: Identical frozen list for both deadlines and all five passes; never count 5 timing repeats as 5 independent targets.

transitions.guard: elapsed_ns >= deadline_ns; checked before and after each pose evaluation and update
both internal stop tolerances satisfied before deadline; provisional until independent validation
200 completed updates; final pose evaluated, no convergence
configured consecutive projected tiny updates; final pose evaluated
nonfinite computation, invalid backend result, linear solve exception
independent Profile B fails despite solver success flag
independent FK fails or is nonfinite
independent analytic proof verified; never inferred from a solver status

status_model.failure_reachability: UNRESOLVED unless independently proved; technical termination code retained in solver_status
status_model.proof_policy: Main/hard FK-generated targets are KNOWN_REACHABLE kinematically. Analytic outside fixture may use norm(target_position)>sum(norm(origin_translation) for every base-to-TCP chain joint)+ProfileA_position_tolerance+1e-12 m, with triangle-inequality certificate, model/TCP identity and numerical margin recorded; ell is NOT an outer reach bound. Otherwise proof is absent and PROVEN_UNREACHABLE is forbidden.

measurement.loop_order: deadline_ms ascending, measurement_pass_index 0..4, frozen query order
measurement.warmup: Before each deadline block run first 20 frozen queries once outside measurement passes; record separately. Warmup repeats are not independent targets. Measurement records are warm; cold initialization is separate environment evidence.
measurement.solve_elapsed_ns: Outer interval around solver call, including input checking and loop/return overhead; initialize model/adapters outside interval.
measurement.validation_elapsed_ns: Immediately after solver return through independent Pinocchio validation and deadline verdict.
measurement.total_elapsed_ns: Same clock endpoints spanning solver and validation; total=solve+validation. No loading, warmup, JSON or file IO in this interval; those intervals reported separately.
measurement.deadline_rule: Per profile: independent geometry passes AND total_elapsed_ns <= budget AND solver_status not in TIMEOUT, INVALID_INPUT, NUMERICAL_FAILURE. A late solver or late validator can never pass deadline.
measurement.timeout_geometry: Validate last finite candidate after timeout; preserve independent A/B geometry flags even if late. Do not resume iterations after timeout.
measurement.determinism: Query bytes and configs are deterministic. Wall-time fields are not. Deadline-driven iteration/status/candidate fields can also vary. Compare deterministic solver behavior with deadline disabled on small fixtures, not timed records byte-for-byte.

schema_policy.null: Only explicitly nullable candidate/errors/iteration/first-hit/proof fields; never substitute zero. Null iteration has iteration_availability=NOT_AVAILABLE. Missing first-hit means NOT_REACHED, not iteration zero.
schema_policy.nonfinite: NaN and +/-Inf, including nonstandard JSON tokens, forbidden recursively. Use null only where declared and an explicit failure/reason.
schema_policy.enums: Case-sensitive closed sets; unknown values and additional fields rejected.
schema_policy.validation_layers: JSON structure + cross-field invariants + independent FK recomputation + query/config/hash binding; schema alone cannot authenticate a result.

acceptance.stage1: Only analytic, mathematics, small robot smoke, schema/contract and production-injected mutation tests. No full queries, CLI, JSONL or final runner.
acceptance.stage2: Explicit user approval required; T-F08, full regression, CLI/end-to-end mutations, query reproducibility/independence and complete evidence required.
acceptance.low_success_rate: Report measured baseline without invented pass threshold or posthoc tuning.
acceptance.aggregation: Separate subset/start/profile/deadline groups. N is unique query_group_id; rate denominator is all 5*N attempts with per-pass rates also reported. All-query latency includes every failure. Successful-query latency is separate per geometry/deadline criterion. Percentiles use numpy linear method; missing errors/iterations excluded only with explicit missing counts; empty statistics null, never zero.
acceptance.safety_claim: Kinematic only; collision NOT_CHECKED, no physical safety or calibration claim.
